phase_1.title: Phase 1 · RPK-74M Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 5.45×39mm M74 primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 380 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 380 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 590 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 960 m/s (1580 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 45-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the RPK-74M staged for its 600 RPM cyclic (closed-bolt · 45-rd magazine) cadence.

zh.headline: 莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪：1974 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 与 AK-74 同步研制的 RPK-74M 贯彻苏军「班用武器零部件高度通用」哲理：通过 1.5 mm 加厚鼓包耳轴机匣、590 mm 重型长枪管、前端折叠两脚架与 45 发高容弹匣，在仅 4.7 kg 重量下赋予步兵班与步枪手零切换成本的持续压制火力。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：RPK-74M 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1974 年问世的 莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 由苏联莫洛特机械厂（Molot-Oruzhie）主导研制，定位为经典的班用轻机枪。与采用开膛弹链供弹的北约 M249 路线不同，RPK-74M 的轻量化闭膛弹匣班用自动步枪思路后来在美军海军陆战队 M27 IAR 选型中意外殊途同归。
与 AK-74 同步研制的 RPK-74M 贯彻苏军「班用武器零部件高度通用」哲理：通过 1.5 mm 加厚鼓包耳轴机匣、590 mm 重型长枪管、前端折叠两脚架与 45 发高容弹匣，在仅 4.7 kg 重量下赋予步兵班与步枪手零切换成本的持续压制火力。 整件装备总长 1,060 mm（590 mm 长重枪管 · 折叠托）、空重 4.7 kg，成为同期轻机枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1974 年，苏联莫洛特机械厂（Molot-Oruzhie）推出了划时代的莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪。与采用开膛弹链供弹的北约 M249 路线不同，RPK-74M 的轻量化闭膛弹匣班用自动步枪思路后来在美军海军陆战队 M27 IAR 选型中意外殊途同归。 它的核心设计聚焦于1.5 mm 加厚冲压机匣与外凸加强前耳轴承受高频连发高热载荷，刚性倍增，奠定了其在轻机枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 的机械灵魂在于其「长行程导气活塞 · 加厚 1.5 mm 鼓包耳轴机匣与 590 mm 重型长枪管」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。590 mm 重轮廓镀铬长管将 5.45mm 枪口初速提升至 960 m/s，侵彻与存能更强，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 采用长行程导气活塞 · 加厚 1.5 mm 鼓包耳轴机匣与 590 mm 重型长枪管。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了590 mm 重轮廓镀铬长管将 5.45mm 枪口初速提升至 960 m/s，侵彻与存能更强。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 5.45×39mm M74 弹药规格与 590 mm 重轮廓镀铬枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 200 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 380 MPa，可赋予弹头 960 m/s 的出膛初速与 1,580 J 动能，有效作用距离达 600 米。
内膛技术特点方面，590 mm 加长重管将 5.45mm 初速推升至 960 m/s，显著拓宽直射距离。同时，与 AK-74M 共享超过 70% 核心零件与弹匣接口，战地后勤维护极其简便，令其在 600 发/分（闭膛高精点射 · 45 发加长弹匣） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 590 毫米身管与 5.45×39mm M74 口径，莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 实现了每秒 960 米的初速与 600 米有效射程。590 mm 加长重管将 5.45mm 初速推升至 960 m/s，显著拓宽直射距离，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 45 发容量的45 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 44 mm 膛轴设计，莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.9 N·s 水平。可调风偏缺口照门、前端一体折叠两脚架与左侧燕尾瞄镜轨兼顾伏击精度。

acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 45 发容量的45 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，可调风偏缺口照门、前端一体折叠两脚架与左侧燕尾瞄镜轨兼顾伏击精度。欢迎在 BAY-54 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 莫洛特 RPK-74M 班用轻机枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the RPK-74M
paragraphs: Introduced in 1974 by Molot-Oruzhie (Vyatskiye Polyany) in Soviet Union, the Molot RPK-74M emerged as a defining Squad Automatic Weapon. Long contrasted with NATO’s belt-fed M249, the RPK-74M’s lightweight closed-bolt, magazine-fed squad automatic philosophy was later echoed conceptually by the USMC’s M27 IAR.

Fielded alongside the AK-74 under Soviet squad-commonality doctrine, the RPK-74M pairs a 1.5 mm bulged-trunnion receiver, 590 mm heavy barrel, folding muzzle bipod, and 45-round magazine to deliver 600 m squad suppression at just 4.7 kg. Measuring 1,060 mm (590 mm Heavy Barrel · Side-Folder) at an unloaded weight of 4.7 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Machine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1974, Molot-Oruzhie (Vyatskiye Polyany) of Soviet Union introduced the Molot RPK-74M. Long contrasted with NATO’s belt-fed M249, the RPK-74M’s lightweight closed-bolt, magazine-fed squad automatic philosophy was later echoed conceptually by the USMC’s M27 IAR. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Reinforced 1.5 mm stamped receiver and bulged front trunnion endure sustained automatic heat loads — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Molot RPK-74M sits its Long-Stroke Gas Piston · Reinforced 1.5 mm Bulged-Trunnion Receiver & 590 mm Heavy Barrel. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 380 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 590 mm heavy chrome-lined barrel raises 5.45mm velocity to 960 m/s for extended reach, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.

During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 590 mm heavy chrome-lined barrel raises 5.45mm velocity to 960 m/s for extended reach.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 5.45×39mm M74 with 590 mm Heavy-Contour Chrome-Lined Barrel (4-Groove RH · 200 mm Twist), the Molot RPK-74M develops 960 m/s muzzle velocity and 1,580 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 600 meters.

Internally, Extended 590 mm heavy barrel boosts 5.45mm velocity to 960 m/s for flatter 600 m point-blank reach. Combined with its 600 RPM cyclic (closed-bolt · 45-rd magazine) tempo, Shares over 70% parts and magazine commonality with the AK-74M rifle for streamlined logistics, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 5.45×39mm M74 through its 590 millimeter bore, the Molot RPK-74M achieves 960 meters per second and 600 meters of effective reach. Extended 590 mm heavy barrel boosts 5.45mm velocity to 960 m/s for flatter 600 m point-blank reach.
